Introduction

AxMxP is a four-member boy rock band under FNC Entertainment. Their name, pronounced “A.M.P,” draws inspiration from the word “amplifier,” symbolizing their aim to amplify their voices and reach listeners around the world. Just two days later, on February 18, the trainees were introduced to the public as the opening act for FTISLAND’s 2024 Live ‘Hey Day’ concert in Taipei, offering audiences an early glimpse of their stage presence.

The group continued to build anticipation throughout the year. On December 20, FNC confirmed the band’s name as AxMxP, and they went on to make a guest appearance at the agency’s year-end family concert, Love FNC Countdown, in Seoul on December 31. That same night, the members opened their official social media accounts, signaling the start of their activities as a team. Around this time, member Ha Yoo Joon also gained attention when he appeared in a teaser released on December 23 for the SBS drama Spring of Youth. Momentum carried into 2025 with the official announcement of their debut. On August 14, it was reported that AxMxP would release their first album on September 10. Pre-orders for the self-titled record opened on August 26, setting the stage for the band’s first step into the industry.
